"""Refunds of card payments through the payment provider."""

import uuid

from . import audit
from .errors import BillingError
from .gateway import GatewayTimeout
from .money import ZERO, round_money

MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3


def refund_via_provider(payment, amount, gateway):
    """Refund ``amount`` of a captured payment through the payment provider.

    The provider is asked to refund the amount, then the refund is applied to
    the payment. Only captured payments can be refunded, the amount must be
    positive, and the total refunded must never exceed the captured amount.
    The provider is retried at most three times on ``GatewayTimeout``; if it
    never answers the payment is left unchanged and ``BillingError`` with code
    ``provider_unavailable`` is raised.
    """
    amount = round_money(amount)

    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))

    already_refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount or ZERO)
    if already_refunded + amount > round_money(payment.amount):
        raise BillingError("refund_exceeds_captured", str(amount))

    # A stable idempotency key per logical refund: retries reuse it so the
    # provider does not move money twice if an earlier answer was lost.
    idempotency_key = f"refund_{payment.id}_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"

    refund_id = None
    for _ in range(MAX_ATTEMPTS):
        try:
            refund_id = gateway.refund(payment.id, amount, idempotency_key)
            break
        except GatewayTimeout:
            continue

    if refund_id is None:
        raise BillingError("provider_unavailable")

    payment.refunded_amount = already_refunded + amount
    if payment.refunded_amount >= round_money(payment.amount):
        payment.status = "refunded"

    if getattr(payment, "provider_refund_ids", None) is None:
        payment.provider_refund_ids = []
    payment.provider_refund_ids.append(refund_id)

    audit.record("payment_refunded", payment_id=payment.id, amount=amount)

    return payment
EOF
python -m pytest -q"}

from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.gateway import PaymentGateway
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.provider_refunds import refund_via_provider
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

def mk(): return Payment("p","i",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")

# full refund
p=mk(); g=PaymentGateway(); refund_via_provider(p,Decimal("100.00"),g)
assert p.status=="refunded" and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("100.00") and p.provider_refund_ids==["re_1"]

# partial then full
p=mk(); g=PaymentGateway(); refund_via_provider(p,Decimal("40"),g); refund_via_provider(p,Decimal("60"),g)
assert p.status=="refunded" and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("100.00")

# timeout then ok
p=mk(); g=PaymentGateway(["timeout","ok"]); refund_via_provider(p,Decimal("10"),g)
assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("10") and len(g.calls)==2

# lost then retry: idempotency prevents double money
p=mk(); g=PaymentGateway(["lost","ok"]); refund_via_provider(p,Decimal("10"),g)
assert g.money_moved==Decimal("10.00") and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("10")

# all timeouts -> unchanged, error
p=mk(); g=PaymentGateway(["timeout","timeout","timeout"])
try: refund_via_provider(p,Decimal("10"),g); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="provider_unavailable"
assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("0.00") and p.status=="captured" and len(g.calls)==3

# validation before provider
p=mk(); g=PaymentGateway()
for amt in (Decimal("0"),Decimal("-1")):
    try: refund_via_provider(p,amt,g); assert False
    except BillingError: pass
assert g.calls==[]
p2=Payment("p2","i",Decimal("100"),status="authorized")
try: refund_via_provider(p2,Decimal("10"),g); assert False
except BillingError: pass
assert g.calls==[]
p3=mk(); p3.refunded_amount=Decimal("90")
try: refund_via_provider(p3,Decimal("20"),g); assert False
except BillingError: pass
assert g.calls==[]
print("all edge cases ok")
EOF"}

p=mk(); g=PaymentGateway(); refund_via_provider(p,Decimal("100.00"),g)
assert p.status=="refunded" and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("100.00") and p.provider_refund_ids==["re_1"]

# partial then full
p=mk(); g=PaymentGateway(); refund_via_provider(p,Decimal("40"),g); refund_via_provider(p,Decimal("60"),g)
assert p.status=="refunded" and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("100.00")

# timeout then ok
p=mk(); g=PaymentGateway(["timeout","ok"]); refund_via_provider(p,Decimal("10"),g)
assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("10") and len(g.calls)==2

# lost then retry: idempotency prevents double money
p=mk(); g=PaymentGateway(["lost","ok"]); refund_via_provider(p,Decimal("10"),g)
assert g.money_moved==Decimal("10.00") and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("10")

# all timeouts -> unchanged, error
p=mk(); g=PaymentGateway(["timeout","timeout","timeout"])
try: refund_via_provider(p,Decimal("10"),g); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="provider_unavailable"
assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("0.00") and p.status=="captured" and len(g.calls)==3

# validation before provider
p=mk(); g=PaymentGateway()
for amt in (Decimal("0"),Decimal("-1")):
    try: refund_via_provider(p,amt,g); assert False
    except BillingError: pass
assert g.calls==[]
p2=Payment("p2","i",Decimal("100"),status="authorized")
try: refund_via_provider(p2,Decimal("10"),g); assert False
except BillingError: pass
assert g.calls==[]
p3=mk(); p3.refunded_amount=Decimal("90")
try: refund_via_provider(p3,Decimal("20"),g); assert False
except BillingError: pass
assert g.calls==[]
print("all edge cases ok")
